Scottish Government organogram theme

Source: R/theme.R
theme_scotgov.Rd

Returns the default grade palette and retains sgplot as a mandatory dependency for Scottish Government visual consistency.

Usage

theme_scotgov(
  colours = c(C3 = "#005EB8", C2 = "#2B7BBB", C1 = "#5B9BD5", B3 = "#A5A5A5", B2 =
    "#D0D0D0", B1 = "#EFEFEF")
)

Arguments

colours

Optional named grade colour vector.

Value

A list containing colours and styling constants.

Examples

theme_scotgov()
#> $colours
#>        B1        B2        B3        C1        C2        C3 
#> "#EFEFEF" "#D0D0D0" "#A5A5A5" "#5B9BD5" "#2B7BBB" "#005EB8" 
#> 
#> $vacancy_fill
#> [1] "#FFF2CC"
#> 
#> $font
#> [1] "Arial"
#>
